en: Soldiers are pale yellowish brown on the head and pale yellowish white on the thorax and abdomen, the head sparsely hairy and the abdomen denser. The head capsule is rectangular, its sides nearly parallel and slightly narrowed at the middle, with broadly rounded hind angles. Frontal peaks are distinctly raised and the labrum lanceolate. Mandibles are short and hook shaped, antennae have fourteen segments, and the postmentum has a pentagonal broad anterior region and a narrow waist.
soldier: 兵蚁头部淡黄褐色，胸部与腹部为淡黄白色，头壳上的毛稀疏而腹部毛稍密。头壳呈长方形，两侧边接近平行，中段稍稍收窄，后侧角宽阔而圆。额峰明显隆起，上唇作矛形。上颚短，呈钩状，触角十四节。后颏前宽区为五角形，腰部细窄。前胸背板前缘中央切入很深，后缘仅浅凹，中区毛细小，数目约八根。
